final: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL)/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM b) AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.*, a.avgshare FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avgshare) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avgshare) AS avg_excess FROM k
